trust_decision.summary: Whether an HTTP request to a built-in side-effecting dev-server route (rebuild / launch editor) was initiated by the dev server's own origin; at the pinned commit the two route handlers act on any GET/HEAD and only a global no-cors+cross-site block exists.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'internal developer endpoints'; grepping /webpack-dev-server/ lands directly on the adjacent invalidate and open-editor middlewares in setupMiddlewares.

fix_sites.entry_point: new private helper #isSameOriginRequest added next to isSameOrigin, used by both handlers (fix.diff:56-78)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fixed handlers sit adjacent in lib/Server.js:2154-2207; no second implementation, wrapper or lower-level API reaching launchEditor/invalidate was found in lib/ or client-src/.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue the existing global cross-origin-header-check (lib/Server.js:2041-2048) already blocks cross-site no-cors loads, so only one endpoint (open-editor, the 'dangerous' one) or only cors-mode fetches need handling; also that same-site (another localhost port) is trusted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The error overlay's click-to-open does a same-origin relative fetch to open-editor (GET, no Origin header, Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin); manual navigation to /invalidate (Sec-Fetch-Site: none) and curl (no Sec-Fetch, no Origin) must keep working. A fix that requires an Origin header, or rejects 'none', breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: Sec-Fetch-Site present: only 'same-origin' or 'none' allowed; 'cross-site' and 'same-site' rejected (fix.diff:66-68)
Sec-Fetch-Site absent and no Origin header: allowed (fix.diff:73-75)
Sec-Fetch-Site absent with Origin: delegated to isSameOrigin Origin/Host hostname comparison (fix.diff:77; lib/Server.js:3337-3391)
Any Sec-Fetch-Mode (cors, navigate, no-cors) — mode is not consulted, unlike the global check at lib/Server.js:2041-2044
Both GET and HEAD (check placed after the method gate, lib/Server.js:2164 and 2185)

O7_producer.where: Trust is derived from request headers only; no schema/serializer/cache produces the state.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A ws client->server message (e.g. 'open-editor' / 'invalidate') handled on the HMR socket, reaching the same launchEditor/invalidate sinks via another transport
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The overlay already talks to the server over this socket; moving click-to-open onto it to avoid an extra HTTP route is a plausible refactor, and it would sit in another file where the HTTP fix never looks (a real second implementation at distance).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A further built-in route (e.g. /webpack-dev-server/restart or a POST variant of invalidate) registered in setupMiddlewares calling this.invalidate()/restart without the origin check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Built-in routes are added ad hoc in setupMiddlewares with no shared guard; WHERE-type only, counts as an extra.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HOW-type: fallback trusts isSameOrigin, which returns true for allowedHosts 'all', DEFAULT_ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS origins, and any Origin hostname in allowedHosts — a planted variant could accept Sec-Fetch-Site 'same-site' (other localhost port) or treat a 'null' Origin as absent
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same-site vs same-origin and null-Origin handling are common mistakes when reusing an existing Host-check helper for CSRF.

O9_family: CSRF / missing origin verification on state-changing GET endpoints (CWE-352, CWE-749 exposed dangerous method)

O10_build.toolchain: npm + jest; e2e tests use webpack and puppeteer (built-in-routes.test.js), the new tests use plain node:http
O10_build.project_tests: test/e2e/cross-origin-request.test.js (fix adds a describe block, fix.diff:164-253); test/e2e/built-in-routes.test.js:99-124 covers invalidate via navigation

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend the global cross-origin-header-check to block all Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site requests, or require Origin to match Host on open-editor only — the first breaks nothing visible but misses non-Sec-Fetch clients with a foreign Origin, the second leaves invalidate open and breaks the overlay's Origin-less same-origin fetch.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix also bumps launch-editor ^2.6.1 -> ^2.14.1 (fix.diff:150-151); fileName from the query is passed unvalidated to launchEditor (lib/Server.js:2197-2202) — argument/command handling lives in the dependency, not this repo.
SockJS transport may not forward the Origin header to the connection-time check at lib/Server.js:2728-2732; not pursued.
